algorithms.html: When making profiles of SHACL 1.2, it is important to identify and present the profile as per the currently known profiles of SHACL 1.2 so they can be used effectively, including by others. Creators of profiles of SHACL 1.2 SHOULD:

steps.html: Identify the profile with an IRI
Describe the profile using The Profiles Vocabulary

Define the profile building on known profiles of SHACL 1.2, as defined in this specification and community-created profiles
  • See 3.3 Known Profiles of SHACL

Share the profile with the SHACL user community
  • Present the profile to the SHACL Resources Repository for inclusion among the SHACL community's known profiles
